mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen over the past 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) signals persistent inflation, prompting expectations of prolonged monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST 3m change < -1% AND RSAFS 3m change < -0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS 3m growth > 0.5%), a tightening labor market signals inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS 3m growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen over the past 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 2017 base (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) from the previous quarter compresses earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 has declined from the previous quarter, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1300 (HOUST < 1300) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
